scope: Read-only bounded review of new W6 consumer E1-E6, host state, layout/public ownership, temporary focus/context cleanup, same-label/disabled IDs, source and Token isolation. No browser, dependency, Git, Figma or publication actions.

findings.title: Clear the old workspace session when the consumer scene changes
findings.body: All six scenes stay mounted with unchanged Workspace keys under hidden/inert. Opening E4 knowledge temporary and changing the task with keyboard/hash retains the old temporary session and Escape owner. Document Escape then dismisses the hidden workspace and attempts to restore focus to its hidden trigger. Returning to E4 without Escape restores the stale temporary panel. The host must clear temporary/focus state on deactivation while keeping business drafts, without editing accepted public sources.

assertions: E4 knowledge index data-temporary=true after open
E4 scene hidden after hashchange to E1
Escape changes hidden E4 temporary to false
jsdom activeElement is the E4 restore trigger inside hidden scene
verification.limitation: jsdom does not implement browser inert focus rejection; root should verify real keyboard scene transition and Escape/focus separately.

findings.resolution: consumer-app.tsx forwards active to all scenes; ActiveSessionGuard closes inactive Workspace temporary/focus sessions with outside intent; CourseResources keys only its ScopeNavigation by activation and retains scope/drafts in the host.

findings.title: Close the portaled scope selector when E1 is deactivated
findings.body: E1 CourseResources remains mounted when hidden. Its ScopeNavigation More state remains open, and its portaled search popup is outside the hidden/inert scene subtree. E1 More open followed by hash/keyboard switch to E2 leaves the visible Search scope popup above E2. An application-owned activation cleanup must close/remount the selector while retaining CourseResources business scope/drafts. Clearing only WorkspaceLayout temporary state cannot close this public popover.
